title: Symbolic: the user function interfaces as they are
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.2: the interface of the symbolic user functions per signature - arguments, return types, how they are transferred to C++ - measured against the Python user functions.
releaseNotes: The user function interfaces measured: 45 user functions in 24 signatures, 39 with a symbolic version, one representative per class against 1.13.6; no Exudyn allocation per call, symbolic 5 to 44 times faster than Python (docs/dev/design/userFunctionBoundary.md, section 13; revision2026c step RG12.2)
